prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, redesign] Interactive Pet Activity & Mood Waiting Stage: Redesign the generation waiting screen into an interactive stage with an animated pet mood simulator while waiting for desktop generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "replace": {"wait_status": [{"role": "wait_status", "type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_mood_sim", "style": "playful"}]}}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive Story Scroll & Mascot Hero Redesign: Redesign the intro story screen into a story scroll layout featuring an animated companion mascot to engage users before path selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "replace": {"intro_story": [{"role": "intro_story", "type": "mascot", "style": "playful"}, {"role": "intro_story", "type": "text", "text": "Meet your future desktop companion and choose how you want to build your bond.", "style": "large"}]}}}
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Companion Personality Alignment Flow: Introduce a interactive choice-card quiz sub-flow directly on the choose path screen to align users with their ideal companion path.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Which pet interaction style fits your workflow best?", "style": "rounded"}]}}
3: [sign_in, redesign] Pet Data Account Safeguard Redesign: Redesign the sign-in options into a spotlight view with explicit pet account sync badges reassuring returning users.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In & Protect Your Pet Data", "layout": "spotlight", "replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"role": "sign_in_options", "type": "badge", "text": "Your desktop companion profiles will safely sync to this account.", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
4: [finish, redesign] Desktop Launch Console & Visibility Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into a split console showing desktop controls, tray icon hints, and visibility toggle instructions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"role": "home_welcome", "type": "checklist", "text": "Right-click system tray to hide/show pet; use desktop shortcuts to trigger commands.", "style": "plain"}]}}}
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Generation Time Remaining Countdown: Display an active countdown timer with progress indicator and desktop readiness notification toggle on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "timer", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "progress", "style": "rounded"}]}}
6: [adoption, hint] Pet Customization Photo Quality Guidance: Add clear photo requirement hints on the photo upload screen explaining lighting and background recommendations.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use well-lit photos with a single clear subject to prevent desktop pet rendering errors.", "show_step_counter": true}}
7: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Name Clarity Copy: Update adoption certificate copy to emphasize that pet names and registration are stored to your account prior to generation.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Desktop Companion Registration", "body": "Give your desktop companion a name. Registration links directly to your profile so your pet is never lost.", "button_label": "Confirm & Start Generation"}}
8: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Connection & Recovery Notification: Add a fallback hint and assist notification on sign-in screen for users experiencing connection stalls.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Stuck loading? Verify your internet connection or choose an alternate sign-in provider below.", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Sign-In Troubleshooter Available", "style": "subtle"}]}}
9: [choose_path, incentive] Starter Companion Perk Showcase: Display a promotional starter badge on the choose path screen highlighting included desktop companion features.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Free Desktop Pet Starter Pack & Customization Items", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns waiting screen into an interactive stage while maintaining progress tracking and wait functionality.
Redesigns story screen while continuing to introduce the pet companion.
Adds a choice-card sub-flow to choose path screen within allowed onboarding customization.
Replacing sign-in options with a static text badge removes the ability to sign in.
Redesigns home intro screen to explain desktop controls within onboarding scope.
Timer is permitted on waiting screen because generation represents a real wait time.
Adds helpful photo quality guidance on upload photos step without violating rules.
Updates adoption certificate copy while preserving the registration/adoption process.
Adds a troubleshooting hint to sign-in screen without removing functionality or violating fair design.
Onboarding copy explicitly mentions 'Free' starter pack extras, violating pricing copy rules.
